messages:
marie: Dropping the initial PRD draft here for the API work: chat/completions streaming, embeddings perf improvements, and a compact rerank endpoint. Need quick read + prioritization input. Goal: decide MVP scope and launch criteria by EOD Tuesday.

devon: Looking now. One big question: should we tie the API to a small set of verified model families or keep it model-agnostic? Also we need concrete perf SLOs to build against.

sam: I vote model-agnostic, but product should list recommended families with verified perf profiles. Tentative perf targets for launch: chat (short <=64 tokens) p50 <= 120ms, p95 < 350ms; embeddings p95 <= 50ms for 512-dim.

li: UX note 12 streaming needs a first-byte within ~80ms or it feels broken. Also add explicit UI state for rerank errors (e.g., "ranking_unavailable").

marie: PRD link (internal): https://redwood.internal/notes/prd/chat-emb-rerank-2026 

olivia: From customers: big asks are large-doc semantic search (embeddings), ecomm ranking (rerank), and agent tool-calls (chat). Prioritize embeddings + rerank for search customers, but streaming is most visible to devs.

devon: Tradeoff: hitting streaming SLO points wants smaller quantized models + aggressive prefix caching. Rerank is a good candidate for batching/async to improve throughput.

sam: Edge cases: extremely long contexts (8-12k tokens). Proposed fallback: truncate context with deterministic policy, compute partial embeddings for rerank scopes, and return a context-warning field in responses.

marie: Draft acceptance criteria I'm proposing:
- chat/completions: streaming supported, p50 <= 120ms for <=64 tokens, correctness regression < 2% on anchor eval set
- embeddings: p95 <= 50ms for 512-dim, cosine similarity delta +/-0.01 vs current baseline
- rerank: synchronous for <=20 candidates under 200ms for 95% of requests; otherwise async with correlation >= 0.95 vs sync baseline
- rollout: canary 5% traffic, automatic rollback on quality or perf regression signals

sam: We need to define "correctness regression" precisely. Suggest metric: anchor eval suite using EM and token-level F1 over curated prompts; log deltas. Put exact numeric calculations in PRD.

devon: Implementation notes: streaming requires KV cache retention across retries and grpc/HTTP streaming hooks in the runtime. Rough estimate: 3 engineer-months total (runtime changes + API + console work). Rerank backend: 2 engineer-months if batching with 100ms window allowed.

li: API UX: streaming should be opt-in (stream=false default). Rerank should optionally include brief explanation tokens for customers that pay for higher cost.

olivia: Enterprise ask: ACME requested deterministic rerank for A/B testing. Need stable seeding and model-version pinning; flagging as enterprise-only feature for now.

marie: Launch checklist items: 1) perf targets met in staging; 2) no critical regressions on anchor evals; 3) docs/SDKs updated and samples published; 4) runbook + rollback tested.

deploy-bot: Notice: nightly perf run complete t; chat p50 = 145ms (above target), embeddings p95 = 62ms (above target), rerank median batch = 180ms.

sam: Nightly shows gaps. Action: profiling pass on hot kernels, enable prefix cache by default in staging, trial quantization profile Q4.

devon: For MVP, propose scoped minimal: streaming only for short chats (<=64 tokens), embeddings sync default, rerank async with optional sync for <=10 candidates. That limits runtime changes.

marie: I can accept a phased SLO approach: MVP SLOs relaxed (e.g., chat p50 <= 170ms) with a firm plan to reach target within 6 weeks of MVP. Document this phase plan in PRD.

sam: Fine, but set a hard engineering milestone for the final SLO in 6 weeks post-MVP.

olivia: I'll adjust customer comms and priority docs; marking deterministic rerank as backlog-high for enterprise.

marie: Action items: devon & sam to produce an MVP tech spec by EOD Tuesday; li to provide API microcopy and error states; olivia will update comms; I'll update the PRD with phased SLOs and rollout plan.

devon: Acknowledged. Spec will include endpoint table, payload examples, and failure modes.

sam: I'll include evaluation harness configs and anchor prompts in the spec.

li: I'll mock error states and brief streaming UX flows tomorrow.

marie: Thanks. If anyone wants to re-prioritize or block scope, call it out here.

kevin: Legal flagged embeddings telemetry retention and enterprise opt-out requirements; we need a compliance task to add an opt-out flag and updated docs.

marie: Added compliance to launch checklist.

olivia: Tentative timeline: aiming for canary in 3 weeks, assuming estimates hold.

devon: Tentatively ok; depends on kernel fixes.

marie: Wrap-up: I'll publish a PRD summary with the phased SLOs and MVP scope. Ping me if anything changes. :thumbsup:
